labor-day-19.question: For October 19, 2026, what percent of sales went to staff labor?

args.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN count(staff_wages_cents)=count(*) AND count(staff_tax_cents)=count(*) THEN sum(staff_wages_cents+staff_tax_cents) ELSE NULL END AS loaded_staff_cents, CASE WHEN count(staff_wages_cents)=count(*) AND count(staff_tax_cents)=count(*) THEN sum(staff_wages_cents+staff_tax_cents)*1.0/sum(net_sales_cents) ELSE NULL END AS labor_ratio, count(*)-count(staff_wages_cents) AS missing_wages FROM daily_rollups WHERE business_date BETWEEN $1 AND $2

labor-day-19.answer: Recorded labor cost was 22% of net sales on October 19, 2026.

cocoa-cost.question: How much does Cocoa cost us in its known recipe cost per item?

args.sql: SELECT m.id,m.name,m.price_cents,r.quantity,i.cost_per_base_unit_micros FROM menu_items m JOIN recipe_lines r ON r.menu_item_id=m.id JOIN ingredient_prices i ON i.ingredient_id=r.ingredient_id WHERE m.id=$1

cocoa-cost.answer: Cocoa's recorded recipe cost per item is CAD 1.90.

latte-units.question: How many units of House Latte were sold on October 19, 2026?

args.sql: SELECT sum(l.quantity) AS units FROM order_lines l JOIN orders o ON l.order_id=o.id JOIN menu_items m ON l.menu_item_id=m.id WHERE m.name=$1 AND o.business_date BETWEEN $2 AND $3 AND NOT l.voided

latte-units.answer: House Latte sold 42 units on October 19, 2026.
